children: AMLBot said some of the stolen funds from the Bitget hack appear to have started mixing through Wasabi CoinJoin. According to Odaily, the funds initially came from a Bitget TRON wallet, where the attacker swapped TRX for USDT, bridged the USDT0 to Ethereum, exchanged it for about 145 ETH, and then used THORChain to convert it into about 4.59 BTC. The BTC was later split, preprocessed, and then entered CoinJoin.

title: Bitget Hack Funds Suspected to Enter Wasabi CoinJoin After Cross-Chain Swaps
